inputs.sbc_source: None disclosed: J-GAAP filer with no share-based payment expense line and no equity-award tax withholding in the FY2026 cash flow statement (parser adjudicated StockBasedComp = 0 and EquityAwardTaxes = 0 for every year). SBC-zero market; SBC rows kept explicit at 0%.
inputs.fx_note: fx_rate converts JPY per ORDINARY share into USD per NTDOY ADR and folds in the ADR ratio: 0.25 ordinary share per ADR / 157.83 JPY per USD (Yahoo JPY=X, 2026-10-03T21:07Z) = 0.0015840. ADR ratio verified by parity: 7974.T closed JPY 7,849 (2026-10-02 06:30Z) / 157.83 = USD 49.73 per ordinary share; / NTDOY 12.44 (2026-10-02 20:00Z) = 3.998 ADRs per share, i.e. 1 ADR = 1/4 ordinary share (4 ADRs per share post the 1-Oct-2022 10:1 split). shares_outstanding is in ORDINARY shares (millions), matching the filings; per-share JPY values are per ordinary share (comparable to 7974.T), the USD values are per ADR. refresh_price.py moves the ADR price but not this rate; re-date the rate on the next update.
inputs.share_count_basis: Ordinary shares outstanding = 1,287,260,000 issued less 134,431,295 treasury at 31-Mar-2026 (FY2026 AR p.~1422/1538; treasury unchanged to 31-May-2026) = 1,152.83m. No dilutive securities of consequence. Held FLAT: no SBC, and the FY2026 Y99.9bn buyback only absorbed a secondary sell-down by partner banks/DeNA and was cancelled.
inputs.wacc_rationale: JPY flows discounted at a JPY rate: 10y JGB ~1.8% + equity risk premium ~6.0% x beta ~1.0 = ~7.8%, rounded to 8.0%. No debt, so WACC = cost of equity. Same rate in all three scenarios: hit-dependence and the hardware cycle are charged in the scenario flows, not as a WACC premium (adaptation f).
inputs.lease_treatment: J-GAAP filer: operating leases are expensed inside operating profit and no lease liability is recognised, so no lease line in the flows and none in net debt.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI is immaterial (Y1.2bn of net assets; Y36m of FY2026 profit). Ignored in both flows and bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF with the non-US / cyclical adaptations (dcf-methods routing row 2). Nintendo is an operating company (console hardware + first-party software + IP licensing) with no debt; not a bank/REIT/LIC. First valuation of this ticker (no MEMORY.md entry). FLOWS are OPERATING only: EBITDA = J-GAAP operating profit + depreciation (FY2026 360,117 + 15,854 = 375,971). Every non-operating stream is stripped and its source asset is in the bridge (matching-asset rule): interest income (Y46.1bn FY2026) <-> cash & deposits 1,791,802 + current securities 425,054 = net cash 2,216,856; equity-method share of profit (The Pokemon Company 32% + two small associates; Y82.8bn FY2026) <-> associates in equity_bridge at a normalised earnings value; dividends on AFS holdings <-> non-associate investment securities at fair value in equity_bridge. FX gains (Y44.3bn FY2026) are not modelled. Balance sheet is the 31-Mar-2026 annual: the Q1 FY2027 presentation (latest filing) carries no balance sheet; the H1 FY2027 report (30-Sep-2026) is due early November. CYCLE BASE: FY2026 is the Switch 2 launch year (revenue +98.6%, hardware-heavy mix, OP margin 15.6%); FY2025 was the pre-launch trough (reported FCF -6.9bn on a Y334bn inventory build). Neither is extrapolated: year 1 is anchored to FY2027 guidance (sales Y2,050bn, OP Y370bn at an assumed Y150/USD vs ~158 spot), and the terminal margin is a full-cycle average, not a peak. Switch 1 cycle (FY2018-FY2025) averaged ~28% OP margin; the Wii U cycle (FY2015-FY2017) averaged ~5-6%; base terminal EBITDA 24% sits between. Buybacks: Y99.9bn FY2026 (offsetting a secondary sale), ~nil in FY2024-25; Nintendo is not a systematic repurchaser, but with no SBC the flat count needs no funding. Working capital: inventory + receivables exceed payables + contract liabilities (~12% of revenue), so wc_capture is NEGATIVE (growth consumes cash, decline releases it).

equity_bridge.item: Equity-method associates (The Pokemon Company 32% + two others) at normalised earnings value
equity_bridge.note: Book value Y278,251m (FY2026 AR note *4). Share of profit FY2022-26: 26.7 / 26.6 / 30.1 / 35.1 / 82.8bn; FY2026 boosted by Pokopia, Legends Z-A and the TCG cycle. Normalised Y45bn x 12x after-tax = Y540bn. Income is excluded from the flows (it sits below operating profit), so the asset belongs here.

equity_bridge.item: Non-associate investment securities (non-current, AFS at fair value)
equity_bridge.note: FY2026 BS investment securities 420,875 less associates 278,251. Current 'Securities' 425,054 are already inside cash/net_debt.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 9.5% diverges >30% from revenue 5yr 5.6% and EPS 5yr -2.0%. Equity compounds through a retained cash/securities pile (Y2.2tn) rather than operating growth, so the equity CAGR overstates business growth; revenue 5yr (FY2021 Switch-1 peak to FY2026 Switch-2 launch, roughly peak-to-peak) is selected instead.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series = reported FCF (OCF - capex) less interest income; SBC is zero. Every window is distorted by the console cycle: FY2021 was the Switch-1/pandemic peak (owner FCF Y599bn), FY2025 the pre-launch trough (negative), FY2026 the launch year. Owner FCF CAGR falls further than reported because interest income rose from Y5.7bn to Y46bn with yen rates - none of the gap is SBC. CAGRs are reported for completeness; the projection is anchored to guidance and full-cycle margins, not to any of them.

base.growth_rationale: FY2027 -10% vs guidance -11.4%: guidance assumes Y150/USD and Y175/EUR against ~158 / ~185 realised in Q1 and spot. Then late-cycle decay of Switch 2 hardware (FY2028-31), offset by software attach on a ~37m+ installed base; a successor/refresh in FY2032-33 restores growth. Terminal revenue ~Y2.06tn, near FY2027 guidance - a mid-cycle level well above the Switch-1 cycle average (~Y1.43tn) because Switch 2 prices and digital mix are higher.
base.margin_rationale: FY2027 19.0% EBITDA = guided OP 18.0% + D&A; includes the ~Y100bn memory/tariff headwind and the Q1 IEEPA refund. Margin rises to 26% as the mix shifts to software/digital (61.5% digital in Q1 FY2027), dips through the late cycle and the successor launch (FY2031-32), then settles at a 24% full-cycle average (Switch-1 cycle ~28% OP, Wii U ~5-6%).
base.tax_rationale: 28% on operating EBIT. Reported ETR 25.1-27.9% is flattered by after-tax equity-method income; Japanese statutory ~30.6% less R&D credits. FY2026 cash tax (Y105bn) was low on timing - income taxes payable rose to Y111bn and will be paid in FY2027.
base.capex_rationale: D&A 0.7% and capex 1.2% of FY2026 revenue; asset-light (outsourced manufacturing). FY2027 depreciation guidance Y11bn PP&E plus intangibles amortisation.

scenario_narratives.base: Switch 2 follows a compressed version of the Switch 1 curve: hardware units fall from the 19.9m launch year toward guidance (16.5m in FY2027) and keep decaying, while software units (60m guided, +23%) and the digital share rise, lifting EBITDA margin from 19% to ~26% by FY2029-30. Memory-cost inflation (LPDDR5X +41%) and tariffs are partly absorbed and partly passed on via the September 2026 price rise. A successor or refresh around FY2032-33 compresses margins for a year or two, and the business settles at ~Y2.06tn revenue and a 24% full-cycle EBITDA margin - below the Switch-1 average, well above the Wii U trough.
scenario_narratives.bull: Switch 2 tracks or beats Switch 1: the installed base clears 100m, software attach and Nintendo Switch Online monetise it at Switch-1-peak margins (28-29% EBITDA), IP income (Super Mario Galaxy Movie, theme parks, Pokemon) keeps growing, the yen stays weak versus the Y150 guidance rate, and the successor transition is smooth because backward compatibility carries the library across. Full-cycle margin 28%, revenue trending above Y2.3tn by FY2036.
scenario_narratives.bear: A Wii-U-lite outcome: Switch 2 hardware decays faster than guided (Q1 FY2027 units -34%), the memory-cost squeeze and tariffs persist so hardware is sold near break-even, a key franchise slips or underwhelms, and the yen strengthens toward the Y150 guidance rate or beyond. Revenue drifts to ~Y1.5-1.6tn (Switch-1-cycle average), a weak successor launch around FY2032 drops EBITDA margin to 14%, and the full-cycle margin settles at 16%.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the house 15% to 25% because Nintendo's own history includes a failed platform (Wii U: ~5% margins for three years), guidance already shows Q1 hardware -34% and a Y100bn cost headwind, and results hinge on a handful of franchises. Base 50% is the guided normalisation path. Bull trimmed from 35% to 25% because it needs several independent things at once (Switch-1-level attach, persistent weak yen, contained memory costs and a clean successor transition). The fortress balance sheet removes solvency risk from the bear but not earnings risk.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the operating console/software/IP business on JPY owner FCF through a full hardware cycle, at a JPY cost of equity, and add the Y2.2tn cash and securities pile and the Pokemon Company stake separately. Never capitalise a launch-year or a trough year; capitalise a full-cycle margin. Per-share values are per ordinary share in JPY and converted to USD per NTDOY ADR at 1 ADR = 0.25 share.
key_risks_to_valuation: Hardware-cycle decay faster than guided; successor platform risk (Wii U precedent)
Memory (LPDDR5X) cost inflation and US tariffs compressing hardware margins
Hit-dependence on a handful of franchises (Mario, Pokemon, Zelda, Animal Crossing)
JPY/USD: a stronger yen cuts JPY revenue and raises the USD value of the cash pile - two-sided for the ADR
Pokemon Company stake valued at 12x normalised earnings; FY2026's Y82.8bn share is not repeatable every year
ADR ratio (1 ADR = 0.25 share) and the FX rate are folded into fx_rate; both must be re-checked on update

data_sources.price: NTDOY: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 10.18-22.89 USD. Parity check against 7974.T (Tokyo) and JPY=X from the same API, see inputs.fx_note.
data_sources.financials: Nintendo FY2026 annual report (year to 31-Mar-2026, J-GAAP, millions of yen): balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement, notes *4 (associates) and share data; Q1 FY2027 financial results presentation (6-Aug-2026) for the reaffirmed FY2027 forecast; NTDOY_Metrics.csv for FY2015-FY2026 history.

sanity_check_note.status: scripts/sanity_check.py exit 3 is a FALSE TRIP from the known fx_rate direction conflict (MEMORY: sanity-check-fx-rate-direction-conflict; same as CM, GGB). The script reads inputs.fx_rate as quote->reporting, while dcf_engine.py (which produced the IV) reads it as reporting->quote; here fx_rate also folds in the 0.25 ADR ratio, so every historical anchor price came out ~0.01-0.03 and every multiple ~0.0x ('Implied P/E 0.0x exceeds 2x the 10yr average 0.0x'). No driver fix pass applied: changing the valuation to satisfy a broken comparison basis would be wrong. sanity_check.passed is left false so the gate stays visibly red pending the maintainer fix.
sanity_check_note.hand_recomputed_basis: JPY per ordinary share against the home listing 7974.T: March month-end Yahoo closes (split-adjusted) FY2017-FY2026 against NTDOY_Metrics.csv EPS, equity, EBITDA, revenue, cash and shares. SBC is zero, so the SBC-adjusted and GAAP bases coincide.
sanity_check_note.verdict: PASS on a consistent basis: implied P/E 17.3x < 2x the 23.9x average; implied P/B 2.46x < 1.5x the 4.32x maximum; implied EV/EBITDA 13.4x below the 19.5x average. The house value sits at the low end of Nintendo's own decade of multiples, consistent with capitalising a full-cycle rather than peak margin.
